text:
Maya (Growth Marketing): Team — need a crisp set of launch assets for next Thursday's webinar push. Scope: 1) two-sided benchmark postcard (print + digital), 2) one-page sales handoff (pdf), 3) a banner for the webinar landing hero, and 4) three short social copy variants. Deadline: Wednesday COB.
Ethan (Creative Lead): What are the primary data points to show on the postcard?
Maya (Growth Marketing): Show p50 latency at 512-token workloads, tokens/sec at 16k batch, cost per 1k tokens for hosted vs dedicated, and an explicit note on caching benefit. Use numbers only from the eval doc I linked below. No ad-hoc estimates.
Rory (Content): For tone: direct, engineer-first, but accessible for revenue folks. Headline suggestion: "Smarter Serving, Lower Costs — Real Benchmarks". Would prefer shorter CTA copy for the postcard.
Priya (Design): Formats: postcard 5x7 (print-ready PDF CMYK) + 1200x628 hero banner + 800x800 social tile. One-pager 8.5x11 with editable text layers in Figma. Any brand stricts?
Ethan (Creative Lead): Keep brand color palette; add a high-contrast alternative for accessibility. Use the standardized legend for axes and tokens (we'll pull tokens component from the system file).
Maya (Growth Marketing): Use this eval doc for numbers: https://docs.internal/redwood/evals/production-bench-2026 (internal only).
LegalBot: Reminder — any quantitative claim must carry a source line in small type: include link to the eval doc and the date tested. Avoid statements like "X% faster" unless directly pulled. If using comparative language vs "common cloud configs", be precise.
Rory (Content): I'll draft short social copy variants: (A) "Cut inference spend, keep latency tight. Join our webinar." (B) "When serving wins: what production benchmarking shows." (C) "Inference economics: real numbers, practical levers." Which should be the primary?
Maya (Growth Marketing): A is primary. Keep B & C as alternates for A/B tests.
Priya (Design): Quick question on imagery: do we want product screenshots or purely abstract data viz?
Ethan (Creative Lead): Abstract data viz + simple infra iconography. No screenshots — too noisy for postcard.
FigmaBot: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/serving-wins-launch-kit  comment access open.
Priya (Design): I'll set up a Figma page named "postcard + onepager" and lay out a grid system for print margins.
Ethan (Creative Lead): Deliverable checklist (tidy list):
- Postcard: print PDF (CMYK), web PNG (RGB), layered source in Figma
- One-pager: PDF (editable), copy doc, CTA + routing snippet for sales
- Hero banner: 1200x628 PNG and SVG variant for email clients
- Social tiles: 800x800 (3 copy variants) + 1080x1920 story card
- Accessibility pass: color contrast report and alt text strings
- Legal footnote: small-type source line on each asset
Priya (Design): For sales routing, what metadata should be embedded in the one-pager?
Maya (Growth Marketing): Sales needs a plain-text mapping for the webhook and UTMs. Add this snippet into the Figma notes: 
```
utm_source=serving_wins_campaign
utm_medium=postcard
webhook_id=srv-win-2026
```
Ethan (Creative Lead): Noted. We'll also include a small copy block for disclaimers and measurement method.
Rory (Content): Drafting the one-pager narrative: 1-sentence problem, 3x bullet findings (latency, throughput, cost), 1x recommended action (pin model version, enable KV caching, use dedicated pools for high QPS). Will send draft by tomorrow morning.
Priya (Design): Accessibility variant: swapping brand-accent for dark-slate and increasing marker sizes on the sparkline. Good?
LegalBot: Also flag: if the one-pager instructs customers on configuration (e.g., enabling caching), make sure we don't present it as official support instructions — use phrasing like "recommended" and link to docs.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Good catch. Use "recommended configuration" and link to docs.redwood.com/serving-best-practices.
AsanaBot: Created task: MARKETING-2991 "Serving Wins: postcards + one-pager" assigned to @Priya due 2026-03-30.
Priya (Design): Timeline check: I'll push initial comps to Figma by Monday noon, iterate with Rory in the afternoon, handoff to legal Tue morning, final files Wed COB.
Ethan (Creative Lead): If print proofs are needed, we need to order by Tue morning. Maya, confirm print quantity and shipping address.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Start with a small run: 200 postcards to HQ and 100 to SF office. I'll confirm addresses by EOD.
Rory (Content): Copy snippets to drop in Figma notes: headline + 3 bullets + footnote placeholder.
Priya (Design): Animation question: tiny SVG sparkline draw for the hero banner — prototype or static?
Maya (Growth Marketing): Prototype if easy; otherwise static. No blockers.
Ethan (Creative Lead): Final check: ensure all assets include the tiny source line: "Source: Redwood internal evals (link) — tested Mar 2026" in 8pt type. Legal sign-off required before publishing.
LegalBot: I'll check after Rory and Priya upload. Expect turnaround within 6 hours for small copy and claims.
Maya (Growth Marketing): Thanks everyone — I'll post the eval link again in the thread after I confirm the specific rows to cite. :raised_hands:
